messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

You will be given a piece of text and a list of relational triples in the format of [Subject, Relation, Object] extracted from the text. For each relation present in the triples, your task is to write a description to express the meaning of the relation.

Here are some examples:
Example 1:
Text: Lipitor (atorvastatin) belongs to a group of drugs called statins. Lipitor is used together with diet to lower blood levels of "bad" cholesterol (LDL) and to reduce the risk of stroke and heart attack.
Triples: [["Lipitor", "has generic name", "atorvastatin"], ["Lipitor", "belongs to drug class", "statins"], ["Lipitor", "treats", "high LDL cholesterol"], ["Lipitor", "reduces risk of", "stroke"]]
Relations: ["has generic name", "belongs to drug class", "treats", "reduces risk of"]
Answer:
has generic name: The subject drug is known by the generic (non-proprietary) name specified by the object entity.
belongs to drug class: The subject drug is a member of the pharmacological drug class specified by the object entity.
treats: The subject drug is used to treat or manage the medical condition specified by the object entity.
reduces risk of: The subject drug is used to lower the risk of the medical event or condition specified by the object entity.

Example 2:
Text: You should not use metformin if you have severe kidney disease. Tell your doctor if you have ever had liver disease. Metformin may cause lactic acidosis, a serious condition. Avoid drinking alcohol while taking metformin.
Triples: [["metformin", "contraindicated in", "severe kidney disease"], ["metformin", "use with caution in", "liver disease"], ["metformin", "has serious side effect", "lactic acidosis"], ["metformin", "should be avoided with", "alcohol"]]
Relations: ["contraindicated in", "use with caution in", "has serious side effect", "should be avoided with"]
Answer:
contraindicated in: The subject drug should not be used by patients who have the condition specified by the object entity.
use with caution in: The subject drug may be unsafe or require medical supervision for patients who have the condition specified by the object entity.
has serious side effect: The subject drug may cause the serious or dangerous adverse effect specified by the object entity.
should be avoided with: Patients taking the subject drug should avoid the substance or activity specified by the object entity.

Example 3:
Text: Amlodipine is available as oral tablets in strengths of 2.5 mg, 5 mg, and 10 mg. Overdose symptoms may include rapid heartbeats and fainting. Norvasc is made by Pfizer.
Triples: [["amlodipine", "has dosage form", "oral tablet"], ["amlodipine", "has strength", "2.5 mg"], ["amlodipine", "has overdose symptom", "fainting"], ["Norvasc", "manufactured by", "Pfizer"]]
Relations: ["has dosage form", "has strength", "has overdose symptom", "manufactured by"]
Answer:
has dosage form: The subject drug is available in the pharmaceutical dosage form specified by the object entity.
has strength: The subject drug is available in the dose strength specified by the object entity.
has overdose symptom: An overdose of the subject drug may cause the symptom specified by the object entity.
manufactured by: The subject drug is manufactured or marketed by the company specified by the object entity.

Now please write relation descriptions given the following text and triples. Note that the description needs to be general and can be used to describe relations between other entities as well. Pay attention to the order of subject and object entities. Write exactly one line per relation in the form "relation: description" and nothing else.
Text: Breastfeeding:
Low levels of sertraline and its breakdown products pass into breast milk.
A pooled analysis of 53 mother and infant pairs was conducted.
Exclusively breastfed infants had an average of 2% of the sertraline levels measured in their mothers' blood.
The levels ranged from 0% to 15%.
No side effects were seen in those infants.
There is no information on whether sertraline affects milk production.
Talk with your doctor about the benefits of breastfeeding alongside your need for treatment.
Children:
Sertraline is approved for OCD in children aged 6 to 17 years.
It is not known to be safe and effective in children under 6.
It is not known to be safe and effective for any other condition in this age group.
Children and teenagers taking sertraline should be monitored for worsening symptoms and suicidal thoughts.
This monitoring is especially important early in treatment and when the dose changes.
Children's weight and growth should be checked.
Older adults:
Older adults clear sertraline more slowly.
Triples: [["sertraline", "passes into", "breast milk"], ["sertraline", "has study", "pooled analysis of 53 mother and infant pairs"], ["exclusively breastfed infants", "has sertraline level", "2% of mother's blood level"], ["sertraline", "has level range in infants", "0% to 15% of mother's blood level"], ["sertraline", "has no reported side effect in", "infants"], ["sertraline", "has unknown effect on", "milk production"], ["sertraline", "has administration instruction", "talk with doctor about benefits of breastfeeding and treatment need"], ["sertraline", "approved for", "OCD in children 6 to 17 years"], ["sertraline", "has safety and efficacy unknown in", "children under 6"], ["sertraline", "has safety and efficacy unknown for", "other conditions in children 6 to 17 years"], ["sertraline", "has monitoring requirement", "worsening symptoms and suicidal thoughts in children and teenagers"], ["sertraline", "has monitoring requirement", "early in treatment and when dose changes"], ["sertraline", "has monitoring requirement", "children's weight and growth"]]
Relations: ["approved for", "has administration instruction", "has level range in infants", "has monitoring requirement", "has no reported side effect in", "has safety and efficacy unknown for", "has safety and efficacy unknown in", "has sertraline level", "has study", "has unknown effect on", "passes into"]
Answer:

completion:
approved for: The subject drug is officially approved by regulatory authorities for the medical condition or indication specified by the object entity.  
has administration instruction: Patients taking the subject drug should follow the specific guidance or recommendation specified by the object entity.  
has level range in infants: The concentration of the subject drug in infants' blood is within the range specified by the object entity relative to the mother's blood level.  
has monitoring requirement: Patients taking the subject drug should undergo the specific monitoring or evaluation specified by the object entity.  
has no reported side effect in: The subject drug has not been associated with any adverse effects in the group specified by the object entity.  
has safety and efficacy unknown for: The safety and effectiveness of the subject drug for the condition or indication specified by the object entity are not established.  
has safety and efficacy unknown in: The safety and effectiveness of the subject drug for the population specified by the object entity are not established.  
has sertraline level: The subject group has a specific level or concentration of the subject drug, as specified by the object entity.  
has study: The subject drug is associated with a specific research study or analysis, as specified by the object entity.  
has unknown effect on: The effect of the subject drug on the physiological process or outcome specified by the object entity is not known.  
passes into: The subject drug or its metabolites are present in the biological fluid or substance specified by the object entity.
